caption: The drawing depicts a carved statue of a standing human figure on a rectangular gray pedestal base. The figure is dressed in a knee-length tunic that is predominantly dark green, with red and yellow decorative elements around the waist, shoulders, and hem. The figure wears yellow shoes or boots. Around the shoulders and chest, there is armor-like clothing painted in green and gold. The figure's right arm is bent and holds a spherical object, while the left arm hangs by the side. The figure's head is adorned with a headdress featuring three large feathers colored in green, yellow, and reddish-orange. The hair is dark and visible beneath the headdress. The pedestal is colored in a way that resembles aged wood, with the writing "TOBACCONIST" faintly visible on the front. The background is plain beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Cigar Store Indian
